AMOUNT_LESS_THEN_MINIMUM_ALLOWED.message: The order total is below the minimum payment amount. Increase the amount or adjust the cart before trying again.

MAXIMUM_AMOUNT_PER_ORDER_EXCEEDED.message: The order total exceeds the per-order maximum. Reduce the order amount before trying again.

DAILY_SPENDING_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.message: Your Cryptorefills daily spending limit has been reached. Wait for that limit to reset or review your account tier. Splitting the cart does not bypass this limit.

MONTHLY_SPENDING_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.message: Your Cryptorefills monthly spending limit has been reached. Wait for that limit to reset or review your account tier. Splitting the cart does not bypass this limit.

LIGHTNING_ORDER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.message: This order is above the Cryptorefills limit for Lightning payments: a per-order ceiling on the order total (including its fee), plus daily and monthly ceilings for the delivery email. Reduce the amount or the quantity before trying again.

LIGHTNING_DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.message: The payment partner's daily Lightning budget for this delivery email is used up. Every order placed today with this email counts, paid or not, until the day rolls over. Pay the pending order instead of opening another one, use a different delivery email, or try again tomorrow.

LIGHTNING_MONTHLY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.message: The payment partner's monthly Lightning budget for this delivery email is used up. Every order placed this month with this email counts, paid or not, until the month rolls over. Use a different delivery email or wait for the new month.

PRODUCT_COUNT_EXCEEDED.message: The cart contains more products than allowed in one order. Reduce the product quantity before trying again.

MULTIPLE_LIMITED_PRODUCT_SAME_ORDER.message: This order contains more than one limited product. Remove the conflicting limited products and recheck the cart.

NOT_AVAILABLE_PRODUCT.message: This product is no longer available in the Cryptorefills catalogue. Remove it or choose another product.

OUT_OF_STOCK.message: This product is out of stock. Remove it or choose another product; availability may change later.

NOT_ACTIVE.message: This product is inactive or temporarily paused. Choose another product or check again later.

INVALID_BENEFICIARY_ACCOUNT.message: The delivery email, phone number or beneficiary account is not accepted. Correct the delivery details before trying again.

NOT_ALLOWED_PAYMENT_VIA.message: The selected payment option is not allowed for this order. Choose another payment option offered by this shop, or contact support if none is available.

UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_COIN_COMBINATION.message: This payment method and network combination is not supported. Choose another payment option offered by this shop, or contact support.

LOGIN_REQUIRED.message: These products require a signed-in Cryptorefills account. Sign in to Cryptorefills before trying again. Connecting a Nimiq wallet here is not the same as signing in there.

COUPON_REQUIRES_LOGIN.message: This Cryptorefills coupon requires a signed-in Cryptorefills account. Sign in there, or remove the coupon before trying again.

COUPON_NOT_FOUND.message: The Cryptorefills coupon was not found. Check the code or remove it before trying again.

COUPON_NOT_ACTIVE.message: The Cryptorefills coupon is not active yet. Wait until it becomes active or remove it.

COUPON_ALREADY_SPENT.message: This Cryptorefills coupon has already been redeemed by this account. Remove it or use another eligible coupon.

COUPON_MAX_USAGE_REACHED.message: This Cryptorefills coupon has reached its total usage limit. Remove it or use another eligible coupon.

COUPON_EXPIRED.message: The Cryptorefills coupon has expired. Remove it or use another eligible coupon.

COUPON_BELOW_MIN_AMOUNT.message: The order is below this Cryptorefills coupon’s minimum amount. Adjust the cart or remove the coupon.

COUPON_NOT_VALID_FOR_USER.message: This Cryptorefills coupon is not valid for your account. Remove it or use a coupon available to you.

COUPON_NOT_VALID_FOR_CATEGORY.message: This Cryptorefills coupon does not apply to the selected product categories. Change the selection or remove the coupon.

COUPON_NOT_VALID_FOR_KIND.message: This Cryptorefills coupon does not apply to the selected product kind. Change the selection or remove the coupon.

COUPON_NOT_VALID_FOR_BRAND.message: This Cryptorefills coupon does not apply to the selected brands. Change the selection or remove the coupon.

COUPON_NOT_VALID_FOR_COUNTRY.message: This Cryptorefills coupon is not valid in the order country. Check the intended country or remove the coupon.

COUPON_NOT_VALID_FOR_STORE.message: This Cryptorefills coupon is not valid for the requested store or region. Check the intended store or remove the coupon.

KYC_MISSING.message: Cryptorefills requires identity verification for this order or spending tier. Open your Cryptorefills account and complete verification before trying again.

KYC_PENDING.message: Your Cryptorefills identity verification is already in progress. It typically completes within 20 minutes but may take up to 48 hours. Wait for the result; contact Cryptorefills support if it remains pending beyond that.

VERIFICATION_REQUIRED.message: Cryptorefills requires additional verification before this order can proceed. Review your Cryptorefills account and contact Cryptorefills support if this persists.

SUSPENDED_COIN.message: The selected payment coin is temporarily suspended by Cryptorefills. Wait until it is available again, or choose another payment option offered by this shop.

SUSPENDED_NETWORK.message: The selected payment network is temporarily suspended by Cryptorefills. Wait until it is available again, or choose another payment option offered by this shop.

FULLNAME_MISSING.message: Cryptorefills needs the full name on the account before this order can be placed. Complete your name there, or contact support.

CUSTOMER_BLOCKED.message: Cryptorefills is not accepting orders for this account right now. Contact Cryptorefills support; the shop cannot lift this hold.

PARTNER_DAILY_ORDER_VELOCITY_EXCEEDED.message: The shop reached the supplier's daily order limit. No order was placed and nothing was charged — please try again tomorrow.

PARTNER_MONTHLY_ORDER_VELOCITY_EXCEEDED.message: The shop reached the supplier's monthly order limit. No order was placed and nothing was charged — please try again later.
